samples.question: A light-grey arena spans the entire canvas as a single connected region. Its coloured border carries the initial state of the tracked field: blue border means the field is OFF and orange border means it is ON. Inside the arena, each red toggle dot inverts the field; red dots outside the arena on the white margin are ignorable decoys. Count all interior red toggles over the full arena and flip the initial state once per such toggle. Is the field's final state ON? Answer yes or no.
